children: CTS completed its $50 million acquisition of Millar Holdings, a manufacturing company specializing in advanced pressure sensing technologies.
CTS, a technology manufacturer, on Friday said the acquisition strengthens the company's position in advanced sensing technologies.
The acquisition includes net cash acquired and debt assumed, CTS said.
